promptTemplate: Create one hand-painted crisp retro low-resolution pixel art icon for the original Dead Woods desktop zombie game. Subject: {{subject}} Art direction: worn field kit, realistic materials simplified for a 48 pixel game UI icon, strong readable charcoal outline, muted earth, olive, steel and tan, clear pale edge lighting above, large deliberate pixel clusters and very little fine texture. Fill approximately 75 percent of a square while leaving clean transparent margins. Isolated asset on a genuinely transparent background. No tile, vignette, drop shadow, text, letters, UI frame or glow. Design as if drawn at 48x48 then enlarged with nearest-neighbor.

subjects.club: A heavy worn wooden baseball bat, diagonal from its narrow grip lower left to barrel upper right. Wrapped faded olive grip, warm weathered wood grain.
subjects.takedown: Clear two-person pictogram in full: a survivor directly behind an olive-clad zombie holding it from behind, positioned as a stealth takedown. The forward figure is pale muted grey-green and the rear survivor warm tan. Both silhouettes readable. No gore.
subjects.carry: Full body side-view pictogram of a survivor carrying a limp figure over one shoulder. Make the carrier upright in tan and the carried figure horizontal in grey-green with limbs hanging down. No gore.
subjects.lure: One small slate grey thrown rock with a clearly separated curved dotted trail sweeping from bottom left to top right. A few broad warm cream dashes trace the arc. No other objects.
subjects.hold: One raised open human palm facing the camera in a simple halt gesture. All fingers visible, warm dusty taupe skin and olive field jacket cuff. Clear mitten-like outer contour.
subjects.freefire: Compact side-view steel pistol pointing right, visibly marked by one big angular pale warm ochre muzzle spark. Make the distinct spark large enough to distinguish it from a regular pistol icon at small size.
subjects.eat: Open weathered tin can viewed in three-quarter, with the hinged metal lid folded back, and a pale metal spoon leaning across the opening. Simple large shapes.
subjects.give: Two opposing human hands shown passing one small pale olive-labeled tin can, with hand from below left offering and hand from upper right receiving. Clear simplified clusters. No lettering.
subjects.barricade: Two thick, worn dark tan timber planks arranged as a conspicuous X with steel nail heads. Broad simple silhouette.
